exposure: Maternal use of systemic antibiotics or vaginal antifungal medications
Children born vaginally to mothers who did not use systemic antibiotics or vaginal antifungal medications
Children born vaginally to mothers who used systemic antibiotics or vaginal antifungals
cohort: Children enrolled in the WHEALS birth cohort
finding: Children born vaginally had a lower risk of eczema and sensitization compared with those born via c-section, and this association was stronger for eczema among children whose mothers did not use systemic antibiotics or vaginal antifungal medications during pregnancy.
mod_finding: The protective association between vaginal birth and eczema may be slightly weakened when mothers took systemic antibiotics or vaginally applied medications during pregnancy.
